purpose: Conservative source-connection to packet association and diagnostic timeout/sampling eligibility; no model experiment
time_conversion: Exact Decimal seconds multiplied by 1000000; reject nonintegral microseconds, negative and nonfinite values. Never round.
supported_packets: Classic microsecond PCAP 2.4, Ethernet, up to four 802.1Q/802.1ad tags, unfragmented complete IPv4 TCP/UDP headers and IP payload. IPv4 protocol6/17, not EtherType0x0800. No reassembly, tunnels or IPv6.
orientation: Original Zeek originator/responder tuple and its exact reverse; no first-packet guess; equal endpoints are direction-ambiguous.
known_duration: Candidate only inside inclusive [ts, ts+duration]. Duration is a source-defined core interval and may omit trailing TCP packets. Never extend it.
unset_duration: If source orig_pkts+resp_pkts equals1, consider only a packet at exact source ts. Unknown multi-packet duration is unsupported for assignment and a potential-competitor veto at all times at/after its ts; no end is invented.
ambiguity: Keep all tuple/time candidates. Two or more candidates, or any unsupported temporal competitor, veto a unique association even when labels agree. No nearest time, first match, count-based tie break or clock fitting.
unsupported_packet_veto: Recognizable unsupported IPv4 TCP/UDP packets veto source connections with the same unordered address pair/protocol in their declared interval (or at/after ts if multi-packet duration is unset). No port is invented for fragments. Unsupported packets with no recoverable family are counted separately.
connection_admission: Every candidate packet must be uniquely associated; exact orig/resp packet and IPv4-total-length byte counts, first ts and last ts (known-duration end or single point) must match; no unsupported-packet veto, missed_bytes, tunnel parent or competing candidate. Partial associations are recorded but not transferred as eligible labels.
other_labels: C&C, scans and every other category stay outside the binary comparison, never benign.
new_flow_labeling: Meter all supported packets, including unassigned and excluded categories. Propagate only through the retained raw-packet ordinal to fully reconciled source-connection association. A new record is binary-eligible only if every retained packet has one admitted source connection and the same binary class. Mixed, unknown and excluded records remain explicitly separate. UID is provenance only, not an independent physical episode.
diagnostic_meter: Custom bidirectional unordered IPv4 endpoint-pair+protocol cache; no TCP state or FIN expiration and no Zeek/NetFlow/IPFIX equivalence claim. Before each selected packet, expire its prior cache record when ts-first>=active or ts-last>=idle; equality expires, active wins ties. EOF closes remaining records. Selected packet clocks define the sampled meter. Input timestamp order must be nondecreasing; ties use original packet ordinal.
sampling: Deterministic nested packet selection: SHA256(seed + ':' + original1basedpacketordinal), interpreted as unsigned256bit integer, is below floor(2**256/denominator). Same ordinal decision for all timeout pairs. Denominator1 keeps every supported packet; includes both directions. This is a fixed diagnostic thinning realization, not inference about a sampling distribution.
selection_rule: Grid fixed before packet mapping, for eligibility diagnostics only; do not choose model settings or benchmark sources from these outcomes.
episode_policy: One acquired source scenario is one scenario; no source UID, timeout fragment or time bin is an independent attack repetition. No split roles or benchmark acceptance are assigned.
privacy: Private output uses only packet/source-row ordinals and aggregate statistics, no raw payload or IP/port rows. External review gets generic code, public sources and aggregates only. No replay, DNS, live packet capture, model fit or publication.
